title: Sardine Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with sardines, perfect for a cozy evening. This recipe combines the freshness of herbs with the richness of fish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped sardines, vegetable or chicken broth, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
